notes.title: New functionality, achievements, mini location and a request for players
notes.content:
Greetings to all the players who play our game and those who have visited the game page but haven't bought it yet.
So, we have two pieces of news: good and not so good.

Let's start with the good news - the update:
1. We added new mechanics to the game, namely, breaking door locks with picklocks. At the start of the game you will only have 3 master keys, but in the location can find more. The doors have 3 levels of difficulty hacking: somewhere there are doors that are easy to crack, somewhere difficult, and somewhere even more difficult.
Latch catches at an unsuccessful hack break.
Also, when breaking in, we recommend keeping a kerosene lamp on or lighting torches to ward off the evil demon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685618/7c0672f2554cce567ebf39822405b1874eb6ec1c.jpg

2. Added 2 new achievements: Olympic Flame (to get it, you need to light 10 torches simultaneously on the entire location) and Burglar (to crack 10 doors).
3. now you can't interact with objects through walls.
4) Also added underground minilocation (entrance to which you need to find), it also can come demon + 3 notes from former lighthouse keeper and something else ːsteamhappyː.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685618/e8b5b13c0416d84962e34f3a5ad31cd0db97fa6e.jpg

5. Now some scrimmages do damage to the character. As a reminder, HP can be restored while in a safe lit area.
6. Other minor fixes.

And now for the bad news: we are on the verge of closing our small indie mini studio, because sales of the game are not great, but some players return the game after its completion. We would be glad if the number of returns decreased and you, the players, would help us with distribution of the game. We've written to many big game bloggers asking them to play our game, but unfortunately we got no response...
So if you have the opportunity to write to game bloggers, we'd be very happy to and we'd be able to continue to please you with new games.
Thank you all and see you again.

notes.title: Added achievements, enlarged the map and other improvements
notes.content:
Greetings to all players!
In the game Reclusive have been added achievements - 7 pieces, issued for the performance of certain actions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685618/a78be8611ea5d670e344a99ff71e8182d451a510.png

Other improvements:
1. the location has been enlarged slightly.
2. Added more item spawn points (diesel and kerosene).
3) Fixed a journal of notes, opens when you click on the Tab button. Previously not correct text was displayed. All our notes are added in order.
4. We have added some more kerosene jerrycans.
5. We have added more lanterns and torches. Recall that HP character can be restored by being near the light, so don't forget to replenish generators with diesel or light torches using kerosene.
6. Increased by 3 times the duration of lit torches: now they burn randomly from 3 to 5 minutes.
7. Added photos and pictures of the previous caretaker of the station. They are not added to the note log.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685618/9167bd9464320ed9cef7ce4d1ae2b1cc36505c4d.jpg
8. Now if you get killed by a demon - you load from the last save point. So don't forget to save the game by pressing Esc while in the game and selecting the appropriate menu item.
9. And other minor fixes.

Also please leave feedback and comments on the game in our community.

notes.title: First Day Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
We listened to player comments and introduced the following fixes into the game:
1. the kerosene lamp is now a safe zone and will scare away a demon if it's on.
2. The demon has been made a little scarier.
3. the amount of diesel fuel needed for the lighthouse and generators has been slightly increased.
4. now when a character dies, the game is loaded from the last save. Do not forget to save the game, it is easy to do through the game menu at any time.

Do not forget that with the generator you can secure the lighthouse from the demon. Similar functionality and torches.
